stories.title: Remove gold theme and implement clean Light/Dark mode with toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Gold color tokens (#CA8A04, text-amber/yellow) removed in favor of clean high-contrast neutral palette (slate/zinc: black, white, gray, emerald for success)
next-themes ThemeProvider integrated into root layout with attribute='class' and defaultTheme='system'
Universal theme toggle component (Sun/Moon) available in header on all pages (Landing, Studio, Host, Play)
Both dark mode (dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-100) and light mode (bg-white text-zinc-900) look crisp and readable with high contrast

stories.title: Universal Settings Modal & persistent preferences
acceptanceCriteria: Global Settings button/drawer in top navigation bar across all pages
Configurable toggles: Sound effects (On/Off), Volume slider, Question timer duration default (15s, 20s, 30s), High contrast mode, and Language preview
Settings persist to localStorage under 'exile_user_settings' and hydrate on mount
Closing settings applies changes immediately across the active session

stories.title: Set up Supabase Auth & Google OAuth login flow
acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated /login and /auth/callback route configured using @supabase/supabase-js
Google OAuth provider button with clean iconography and loading states
Email/Password magic link or credentials option with input validation
Auth status drawer in header: displays avatar, name, and logout when authenticated, or 'Masuk / Daftar' when unauthenticated
Teachers can sign in before hosting to save quizzes to their account, with seamless guest fallback

stories.title: Standardize battle-tested UI primitives (no sloppy rewrites)
acceptanceCriteria: Eliminate fragile custom HTML controls in favor of standard components (Lucide/Remix icons, Sonner toasts, next-themes, TanStack Table)
Mobile-first responsive layout with proper tap targets and flex/grid reflow
Clear accessible focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400)

stories.title: Audit and eradicate all hardcoding
acceptanceCriteria: Zero static mock PINs (no '849201' hardcoded as permanent input default)
Zero static student counts (real player count from state.players.length)
Dynamic room creation from Studio generates a unique 6-digit PIN and redirects to host
Student arena joins via real PIN, registers player in Supabase, and updates tally in real time

stories.title: Performance, caching, and resilient API architecture
acceptanceCriteria: Lightweight polling with etag/state comparison or Supabase Realtime WebSocket events
Cache-Control headers configured for static assets and dynamic route handlers
No heavy uncompressed client bundles or redundant background fetches

stories.title: Verification loop, E2E browser test & Quality rubric sign-off
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/verify-full passes with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 lint failures
agent-browser tests theme toggle (light/dark), settings modal, studio quiz launch, and student game arena
All acceptance criteria verified with fresh evidence before marking complete

stories.title: Production Vercel deployment & custom domain live verification
acceptanceCriteria: Production build deployed to Vercel
https://www.exile.web.id and https://exile.web.id respond with HTTP 200/308 over HTTPS
Let's Encrypt SSL certificate remains valid and functional
